justification: Inspected `src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/output/AbstractByteArrayOutputStream.java` and found `InputStreamConstructor` is a protected `@FunctionalInterface` with a single method, `construct(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length)`, used only as a callback in `toInputStream(...)` (lines 69-80 and 260-275). The related implementations in `ByteArrayOutputStream.java` and `UnsynchronizedByteArrayOutputStream.java` each pass a single constructor method reference/lambda, so this unit is a small single-purpose interface rather than an incompletely decomposed class.
